camera.ground_material_projection: orthographic top-down; the runtime Iso ground transform provides the camera

review: The approved forest reference guides muted olive ground, worn pale limestone paving, natural earth, cream-white flowers, restrained warm wildflowers and fine low foliage. Ground material tiles contain no directional tree/building shadow layer. Flora was reviewed over light and dark solid backgrounds: the visible olive source backdrop is fully transparent RGB, not a rendered halo. Fine leaf holes and antialiasing remain; no painted ground-shadow plate is present. Organic clumps are reviewed for upper leaf visibility and rooted stem contact rather than certified with invented rigid ground-axis edges.

flowers_white.review: Ground-contact centre among lower flower stems and the rooted leaf rosette. White petals retain the generated cream colour; front leaves remain below the contact instead of forcing the foot to the silhouette bottom.

flowers_warm.review: Rooted centre beneath the warm flower stems and central leaf mat. The lower grass tuft and forward leaves remain visible beyond the depth-sort anchor.

fern.review: Ground contact at the converging fern petiole/root crown. The natural spread of foreground fronds and fallen leaves remains below the anchor.

grass.review: Contact at the central rooted grass tuft, beneath the curved upper blades. Low leaves and fine forward blades retain their natural footprint.
